learningObjective: Understand what Relax adds relative to Relay and why the TVM community introduced a new graph-level IR.

canonicalClaims.claim: Relax was introduced in TVM Unity to make symbolic/dynamic shape a first-class citizen, to unify graph-level and tensor-level IR via direct calls into PrimFunc (TensorIR), and to enable Python-native metaprogramming through TVMScript.
conditions: TVM Unity / Relax as documented in the project docs.
nonImplications: Does not imply Relax replaces TensorIR; both coexist.
Does not imply Relay is uniformly deprecated across all TVM deployments.

misconceptions.claim: Relax replaces TensorIR; PrimFunc is legacy.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Both live in the same IRModule; Relax calls TensorIR PrimFuncs for tensor-level compute.

misconceptions.claim: Relax's primary purpose is automatic differentiation.
misconceptions.whyWrong: AD is not the driving motivation; shape/dataflow/staged transformation are.

misconceptions.claim: Relax removes module and function abstractions.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Relax uses IRModule with functions, calls, and dataflow blocks.

misconceptions.claim: Symbolic shape in Relax is only annotation; it does not participate in verification.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Shape variables and constraints are part of Relax's structural type system.

implementationFacts: Relax dataflow blocks vs. imperative blocks separate pure regions from side-effecting ones.
TVMScript is the Python surface for both Relax and TensorIR.
